name: Otaku
description: Discover anime, track your own, and get pinged when new episodes air. Search via AniList, browse by genre, see what's trending, watch parties, server leaderboards — and per-user subscriptions to airing schedules delivered to a server-designated announcement channel.
author: CubCadetXT1
